items.heading: Masgouf
details: Key ingredients: carp, olive oil, tamarind, turmeric
Butterfly a whole fish and season it with olive oil, turmeric and tamarind.
Skewer the fish open beside a wood fire.
Grill slowly, basting occasionally, until the skin is crisp and smoky.
Serve the whole fish with flatbread and grilled vegetables.

items.heading: Dolma Iraqi
details: Key ingredients: grape leaves, vegetables, rice, ground meat
Mix rice with ground meat, herbs and spices.
Stuff the mixture into hollowed vegetables and rolled grape leaves.
Arrange everything snugly in a pot with a little tomato sauce.
Simmer until the rice and vegetables are tender.

items.heading: Biryani Iraqi
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.
